review_notes: I read the whole file and the imported TauCeti.GroupTheory.QuotientGroup.MulAut. That file already has `MulAut.mapQuotient_mk` as a simp lemma and `MulAut.mem_ker_mapQuotient_iff` as a non-simp iff, which is appropriate. The file under review declares no simp lemmas and no simp attributes. Its private `mem_liftsMod` is `Iff.rfl` and is only used explicitly via `.mp`/`.mpr`. Making it simp would expose the carrier predicate and is not justified. Its `simp` calls (`by simp` for `closure (Set.range id) = ⊤`, `QuotientGroup.eq` side goals, `left_inv`/`right_inv`) rely on existing Mathlib lemmas. Two minor things I found are not worth reporting. `MulAut.smul_def` is already `@[simp]` in Mathlib (Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Action/End.lean), so passing it in the `simpa` is redundant. `Subgroup.smul_def` is not simp in Mathlib, so passing it explicitly is reasonable. I did not execute Lean, so I can't rule out simp-set subtleties in the `ext i; simp` proofs.
